title: Sex education
blurb: Biology, psychology, and culture — woven together. A language for boundaries, desires, and needs, without shame.
body:
## More than _biology_

Students often know the mechanics already. What's missing are words for what happens between people: arousal, consent, touch, and the boundaries that shift along the way.

## No one has to have it _figured out_

We also talk about sex and porn, and about everything else that's otherwise hard to say out loud. Not as a syllabus to get through, but as a conversation where doubt is allowed. The format adapts to the group and the setting.
